title: Dating Results for Voynich Manuscript Parchment Leaves 8, 26, 47 and 68
document_type: Original laboratory report addressed to Yale's conservator
summary: The report presents AMS measurements of four parchment leaves, treatment details and calibrated age distributions. It dates the parchment and explicitly distinguishes that result from when writing was applied.
established: Table 2 reports solvent-treated ages for leaves 8, 26, 47 and 68; a second leaf-68 measurement omits solvent extraction.
Using IntCal04 and OxCal 3.10, Figure 7 reports a four-sample mean of 516 ± 18 radiocarbon years BP and a 95.4% calendar interval of AD 1404–1438.
Page 3 motivates combining the measurements through a common-object assumption and cautions that parchment, rather than writing time, was dated.

open.question: Which Table 2 treatment selection reproduces the reported four-sample mean, given the conflicting exclusion wording on page 3?
open.check: Use the printed inverse-variance formula; compare four-leaf selections with either leaf-68 measurement. Report uncalibrated BP means and uncertainties separately from calendar dates; do not infer writing time.

catalogue_note: The prose names solvent-treated leaf 68 as excluded, while describing four Soxhlet-treated samples. This catalogue flags a reproducibility question, not a resolved correction.

reported_measurements.age_units: uncalibrated radiocarbon years BP, before AD 1950

review_provenance.catalogue_duplicate_check: No radiocarbon, parchment, pigment, materials or McCrone source title in the current 35-source catalogue.
review_provenance.scope: Report year is the dated 2009 letter, not the date the public copy was uploaded. Neither ink chronology nor a transcription/key result is added by this catalogue.
